machine./bin/bash: Bazel's own shell: its test wrapper and genrule setup are bash scripts, and every script the graph writes runs in it; what runs in it is plumbing (redirection, exec), whose bytes no shell release changes
machine./bin: the action search path Bazel fixes (never the client's): the machine's coreutils copy, list and print, transforming no content the graph keys on
machine./usr/bin: the action search path Bazel fixes (never the client's): the machine's coreutils copy, list and print, transforming no content the graph keys on
machine./usr/local/bin: the action search path Bazel fixes for its own C++ and genrule actions (never the client's)

tools.git: the tree is the checkout's git index and the stamp its commit: git is the owner of that format, and its listing of one index is the same on every machine
tools.nvidia-smi: the devices' identity (`host_gpu`): a device test's pass is its device's, and the GPU driver is a device test's input by design
tools.sha256sum: verifies a pinned binary against its pin's digest: a different sha256sum can only refuse, never change the content
tools.chmod: marks a pinned binary executable: no content
tools.mkdir: makes the staging directory the environment's local package is copied into: no content
tools.cp: copies the environment's local package into its staging directory: the bytes copied are the input
